head.title: Sugar Swirl Bakery · Gainesville, FL | Giant Donuts & Fresh Pastries
head.description: Sugar Swirl Bakery in Gainesville, FL: giant six-inch donuts, cinnamon rolls, apple fritters and gluten-free options, baked fresh daily. 5.0 stars, 13 Google reviews. Call (352) 358-7218.
head.og_description: 5.0 stars on Google. Giant donuts, cinnamon rolls and apple fritters, baked fresh by Chef Richie.

jsonld.name: Sugar Swirl Bakery
jsonld.description: Bakery in Gainesville, FL specializing in giant six-inch donuts, cinnamon rolls, apple fritters and gluten-free pastries, baked fresh daily.

parrafo.es: El chef Richie glasea a mano donas gigantes de seis pulgadas, rollos de canela y apple fritters en Gainesville, con opciones sin gluten y un sabor limitado casi todos los sábados. Una clienta confiesa que manejó 4 horas y media desde Palm Beach solo por una caja.
parrafo.en: Chef Richie hand-glazes giant six-inch donuts, cinnamon rolls and apple fritters in Gainesville, with gluten-free options and a new limited flavor most Saturdays. One customer admits she made the 4.5-hour drive from Palm Beach just for a box.

hero.imagen_alt: Pastry display case loaded with specialty doughnuts at Sugar Swirl Bakery

parrafo_1.es: Sugar Swirl Bakery es la panadería del chef Richie en Gainesville, conocida por sus donas gigantes de seis pulgadas, rollos de canela y apple fritters hechos desde cero y terminados a mano.
parrafo_1.en: Sugar Swirl Bakery is Chef Richie's bakery in Gainesville, known for oversized six-inch donuts, cinnamon rolls and apple fritters made from scratch and finished by hand.

parrafo_2.es: Las reseñas repiten lo mismo: calidad exquisita, servicio excelente y un menú que cambia todo el tiempo, desde un rollo de canela red velvet hasta una dona de tocino sin gluten hecha a pedido.
parrafo_2.en: Reviews keep mentioning the same things: exquisite quality, superb service, and a menu that keeps changing, from a red velvet cinnamon roll to a gluten-free bacon doughnut made on request.

texto.es: Pregunta qué hay fresco hoy: las donas gigantes y los sabores especiales se agotan rápido.
texto.en: Ask what is fresh today: the giant donuts and specialty flavors sell out fast.

texto.es: Cada dona, rollo de canela y apple fritter se hace a mano, sin apuros.
texto.en: Every donut, cinnamon roll and apple fritter is made by hand, no shortcuts.

texto.es: Desde el clásico glaseado hasta el especial de temporada, incluyendo opciones sin gluten.
texto.en: From the classic glaze to the weekly special, gluten-free options included.

texto.es: Para comer ahí mismo o para llevar, como prefieras.
texto.en: Eat in or take it to go, whichever you prefer.

nota.es: Los sabores cambian seguido. Llama y te contamos qué hay fresco hoy.
nota.en: Flavors change often. Call and we will tell you what is fresh today.

texto.es: Donas enormes, glaseadas a mano, con coberturas que cambian cada semana.
texto.en: Oversized donuts, hand-glazed, with toppings that change every week.

titulo.es: Rollos de canela y apple fritters

texto.es: Hechos desde cero y con mucha atención al detalle, según cuentan sus propios clientes.
texto.en: Made from scratch with real attention to detail, according to their own customers.

texto.es: Un sabor nuevo casi cada sábado, en cantidades limitadas hasta agotar existencias.
texto.en: A new flavor almost every Saturday, in limited quantities until sold out.

texto.es: Donas y rollos de canela sin gluten disponibles cuando los pides con anticipación.
texto.en: Gluten-free donuts and cinnamon rolls available when you ask ahead.

pie.es: ¿Buscas algo para un evento o una caja grande? Llama y lo coordinamos.
pie.en: Looking for something for an event or a big box order? Call and we will set it up.

items.quote: I haven't had a bad experience here, the service and hospitality is out of this world alongside the desserts made. There's always deals, and new recipes being made. You can tell that this chef puts his heart into the baked goods and they taste accordingly. I would recommend this business to everyone and anyone
Local pastry chef delighting the taste buds with his creations. Giant (6") donuts, cinnamon swirls, apple fritters made with love and attention to detail will not disappoint you.
Mr. Richie is UNMATCHED!! The quality was exquisite, the customer service was superb!
